name: RHODEX NatCat Loss — latest report (economic & industry loss)

reports.description: The single most recently added report — no year/ALL params needed, this endpoint always returns the latest record directly. For the current in-progress year, only the quarters completed so far are populated; the full-year total fields only appear once the year finishes.

economic-loss | total.description: Full-year total economic loss, $B — absent until the year completes

industry-loss | total.description: Full-year insured (industry) loss, $B — absent until the year completes

Q3 | economic.description: Field name has a trailing space — matches the live API exactly, not a typo to fix

Q3 | industry.description: Field name has a trailing space — matches the live API exactly, not a typo to fix

data_source_description: RHODEX's latest-report endpoint — the same NatCat Loss dataset as v1, but returns only the most recently added record directly (no ALL-LOSSES array to fetch and index into). Each metric falls back from the full-year total to the latest available quarter, mirroring api/natcat_loss.py's own latest_loss_for_year() logic, since the current in-progress year never has a total until it completes.
